subject: Next steps & VP/CTO alignment — OrchardTech

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Jones <olivia.jones@orchardtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & VP/CTO alignment — OrchardTech

Hi Olivia,

Great connecting earlier — thanks for walking through OrchardTech's inference priorities. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

- Key needs we heard: predictable per-token costs at scale, multi-region failover with low tail latency, and stricter audit logs for compliance.
- Success criteria (stated): pilot handling steady 50k tokens/min with p99 < 350ms and clear billing visibility for team leads.
- Risks: current bursty traffic pattern + homegrown routing makes SLA predictability hard; internal CTO flagged offline model testing as a blocker.

Recommended next steps:
1) Exec alignment (VP Eng / CTO) — 30–45 minute intro to sync on org priorities and pave way for a technical deep dive.
2) Technical deep-dive (Engineering) — 45–60 minutes demo + infra Q&A (we'll bring runtime engineer).
3) Mutual action plan — attached v1. If that looks right we'll lock dates and owners.

Proposed slots for the VP/CTO alignment (all PT):
- Tue, Dec 2 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT (we can do 30 or 45 within this window)
- Wed, Dec 3 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT

If neither works, send a couple of windows that align with David's timezone — I know he's often in APAC mornings. Once we lock the exec slot, I'll follow with a separate calendar invite for the engineering deep-dive (we typically schedule that 48–72 hours after the exec call).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 125 KB); redwood_platform_one-pager.pdf (application/pdf, 78 KB)

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c/view?usp=sharing

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | M: +1 415 555 0198
